correctness.rationale: For each ordered r-set of prescribed indegree-zero vertices, all n arrows avoid the set with probability ((n-r)/n)^n; the complement arrows are a uniform map and determine all cycles. The falling-factorial Palm identity is exact. Binomial expansion at t>=1 produces a normalized positive mixture of uniform cyclic-core distributions. Their exact tails (m)_k/m^k increase strictly with m for k>=2, while the mixture index has strictly increasing likelihood ratio in t, including s=1 by a degenerate limit. The asymptotic negative covariance follows from a uniform Gaussian-tail Riemann expansion for E[C_n]-E[C_{n-1}]; independent occupancy gives the variance constants. The extracted standalone checker exhaustively enumerated all maps for n=2,...,7, passing 486 exact rational assertions. Infinite conclusions rest on proofs, not finite checks.
